title: SynthData_Singularity
summary: An educational Google Colab notebook that teaches synthetic data generation and privacy concepts, walking learners through loading a real dataset, defining metadata, and comparing real versus synthetic distributions. It runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit and generate synthetic tabular data, and uses sdv.metadata.Metadata plus sdv.evaluation.single_table's run_diagnostic and evaluate_quality to build a quality report.
